page.layout: One printed page (left page of an open book) with a running head at the top, text in one main column with diagrams, a note in small type below the text; a narrow strip of the facing right page is visible at the right edge, its text is partly cut off and is not transcribed as main text.

main_text.p: Deinceps primæ alligationis proprietates duæ, & genera totidem sequuntur. Prima proprietas sic est.
Si extrema numero paria sint, singula cum medio semel tantum cóparantur.

Si extrema imparia sint, tunc maioris numeri singula extrema cum medio semel tantum cóparantur: minoris autem numeri extremū, siquidem unicum sit, tum quantus est numerus extremorum maior, toties minoris numeri extremū cum medio comparatur.
In proposito exemplo numerus maior extremorum est 2, & ideo extremū minoris numeri cum medio bis comparatur.

page.notes: Diagram numbers are reproduced from a low-resolution scan and some digits are uncertain (e.g. 1 / 7 and 5 / 3 in the diagrams). Top-right running text belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed.
